{{Top|leg}}
A '''disabler''' was a device that could deactivate the alarms in the weapons testing lab of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technical Branch Outpost]]. The alarm was triggered by anyone entering or leaving the lab with a [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power pack]]; [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] carried a disabler to override the alarm to prevent triggering it during patrols.
